admission.justification: Without admitted omission the master landing refuses nine violations on landed frozen rows, as the first candidate did; the model keeps old history committable.

applicability: Family history rows wherever the knowledge files travel, parsed or written
conditions: The row is already recorded, in a frozen file or an earlier attempt
Effect and own revision are both missing on the recorded row; a half-recorded changed row with exactly one of the two present is not a supported historical shape
exclusions: New or edited changed family rows, which must carry the writer's own revision and the authored effect
New or edited nonchanged family rows, which carry the writer's own revision and no effect
Invariant rows, which keep their own shape

evidence: Model/frozen-row tests in test_family_history_judgments.py; parsed row and complete document in public-four-label-results.json.

statement: Existing family history representation retains optional own revision and authored effect; historical omission of both remains omission.
